import type { SVGProps } from "react";

/** Original glyphs drawn on one 24px grid. Not Apple SF Symbols. */
export type GlassIconName = "arrow" | "diagonal" | "down" | "heart" | "plus" | "check" | "close" | "undo" | "sun" | "moon" | "power" | "restart" | "play" | "pause" | "previous" | "next" | "speaker" | "quiet" | "muted" | "airdrop" | "person" | "people" | "search" | "folder" | "message" | "drawer" | "book" | "components" | "sliders" | "music" | "wave" | "more" | "bookmark" | "bell" | "copy";
export function GlassIcon({ name, ...props }: SVGProps<SVGSVGElement> & { name: GlassIconName }) {
  const paths = {
    arrow: <path d="M4 12h15m-5-5 5 5-5 5" />,
    diagonal: <path d="M6 18 18 6M6 6h12v12" />,
    down: <path d="M12 4v16m-5-5 5 5 5-5" />,
    heart: <path d="M12 20S3.5 15.1 3.5 8.9a4.4 4.4 0 0 1 8.5-1.6 4.4 4.4 0 0 1 8.5 1.6C20.5 15.1 12 20 12 20Z" />,
    plus: <path d="M12 4v16M4 12h16" />,
    check: <path d="m5 12 4.5 4.5L19 7" />,
    close: <path d="m6 6 12 12M18 6 6 18" />,
    undo: <><path d="M8 5 3 10l5 5M3 10h11a6 6 0 0 1 0 12" /></>,
    sun: <><circle cx="12" cy="12" r="4"/><path d="M12 2v2m0 16v2M2 12h2m16 0h2M5 5l1.5 1.5m11 11L19 19M5 19l1.5-1.5m11-11L19 5" /></>,
    moon: <path d="M20.5 14.2A8.8 8.8 0 0 1 9.8 3.5 8.8 8.8 0 1 0 20.5 14.2Z" />,
    power: <path d="M12 2v10M6.4 5.4a9 9 0 1 0 11.2 0" />,
    restart: <><path d="M4 9a8.3 8.3 0 1 1-.3 5M4 3v6h6" /></>,
    play: <path fill="currentColor" stroke="none" d="M7 4.8c0-1 1.1-1.6 2-1l12 7.1a1.3 1.3 0 0 1 0 2.2l-12 7.1c-.9.6-2 0-2-1Z" />,
    pause: <><rect fill="currentColor" stroke="none" x="5" y="4" width="5" height="16" rx="1.3"/><rect fill="currentColor" stroke="none" x="14" y="4" width="5" height="16" rx="1.3"/></>,
    previous: <path fill="currentColor" stroke="none" d="M11.4 5.4c.7-.5 1.6 0 1.6.8v4.2l7.4-5c.7-.5 1.6 0 1.6.8v11.6c0 .8-.9 1.3-1.6.8l-7.4-5v4.2c0 .8-.9 1.3-1.6.8L3 12.9a1 1 0 0 1 0-1.8Z" />,
    next: <path fill="currentColor" stroke="none" d="M12.6 5.4c-.7-.5-1.6 0-1.6.8v4.2l-7.4-5c-.7-.5-1.6 0-1.6.8v11.6c0 .8.9 1.3 1.6.8l7.4-5v4.2c0 .8.9 1.3 1.6.8l8.4-5.7a1 1 0 0 0 0-1.8Z" />,
    speaker: <><path fill="currentColor" stroke="none" d="m4 9 5-4c.7-.5 1.5-.2 1.5.7v12.6c0 .9-.8 1.2-1.5.7l-5-4H1.5V9Z"/><path d="M14 8a6 6 0 0 1 0 8m3-11a10 10 0 0 1 0 14m3-17a14 14 0 0 1 0 20" /></>,
    quiet: <><path fill="currentColor" stroke="none" d="m8 9 5-4c.7-.5 1.5-.2 1.5.7v12.6c0 .9-.8 1.2-1.5.7l-5-4H4V9Z"/></>,
    muted: <><path d="m8 9 5-4v14l-5-4H4V9Zm10 1 4 4m0-4-4 4" /></>,
    airdrop: <><path d="M7.5 18.7a8 8 0 1 1 9 0M9 16.1a5 5 0 1 1 6 0M10.5 13.5a2 2 0 1 1 3 0"/><path fill="currentColor" stroke="none" d="m12 14 4 7H8Z"/></>,
    person: <><circle fill="currentColor" stroke="none" cx="12" cy="7.3" r="3.4"/><path fill="currentColor" stroke="none" d="M5 20v-1.8a7 7 0 0 1 14 0V20Z"/></>,
    people: <><circle fill="currentColor" stroke="none" cx="9" cy="8" r="3"/><circle fill="currentColor" stroke="none" cx="17" cy="9" r="2.5"/><path fill="currentColor" stroke="none" d="M2.5 20v-2a6.5 6.5 0 0 1 13 0v2Zm14.5 0v-2a8 8 0 0 0-1.5-4.6A5 5 0 0 1 22 18v2Z"/></>,
    search: <><circle cx="10.5" cy="10.5" r="7"/><path d="m16 16 5 5"/></>,
    folder: <path d="M3 8h18v10.5a2 2 0 0 1-2 2H5a2 2 0 0 1-2-2V5a2 2 0 0 1 2-2h5l2 3h7a2 2 0 0 1 2 2"/>,
    message: <path d="M20.5 11.3c0 5.2-5.7 8.4-10.2 6.8L5 20l1-4C.6 10.7 4.8 3 12 3c4.7 0 8.5 3.7 8.5 8.3Z"/>,
    drawer: <><rect x="3" y="4" width="18" height="16" rx="3"/><path d="M3 14h18M9 17h6"/></>,
    book: <><path d="M12 5c-3-2-6-2-9-1v15c3-1 6-1 9 1 3-2 6-2 9-1V4c-3-1-6-1-9 1Zm0 0v15"/></>,
    components: <><rect x="3" y="3" width="7" height="7" rx="2"/><rect x="14" y="3" width="7" height="7" rx="2"/><rect x="3" y="14" width="7" height="7" rx="2"/><rect x="14" y="14" width="7" height="7" rx="2"/></>,
    sliders: <><path d="M6 3v4m0 6v8M18 3v10m0 6v2"/><rect x="3" y="7" width="6" height="6" rx="2"/><rect x="15" y="13" width="6" height="6" rx="2"/></>,
    music: <><path d="M10 18V5l10-2v13M10 8l10-2"/><ellipse fill="currentColor" stroke="none" cx="6.5" cy="18" rx="4.5" ry="3"/><ellipse fill="currentColor" stroke="none" cx="16.5" cy="16" rx="4.5" ry="3"/></>,
    bookmark: <path d="M6 3h12v18l-6-4-6 4V3Z"/>,
    bell: <><path d="M5 17h14l-2-3V9a5 5 0 0 0-10 0v5l-2 3Zm5 3h4"/><path d="M12 2v2"/></>,
    copy: <><rect x="8" y="8" width="12" height="13" rx="2"/><path d="M15 8V3H3v13h5"/></>,
    more: <><circle cx="5" cy="12" r="1.8" fill="currentColor" stroke="none"/><circle cx="12" cy="12" r="1.8" fill="currentColor" stroke="none"/><circle cx="19" cy="12" r="1.8" fill="currentColor" stroke="none"/></>,
    wave: <path d="M3 10v4m4-7v10m5-14v18m5-14v10m4-7v4"/>,
  };
  return <svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 24 24" width="24" height="24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" strokeWidth="1.7" strokeLinecap="round" strokeLinejoin="round" aria-hidden="true" {...props}>{paths[name]}</svg>;
}

.glass-state-swap > [data-swap-layer].transition: opacity 180ms var(--ease-out), transform 180ms var(--ease-out), filter 180ms var(--ease-out)

.glass-selection-indicator.transition: transform 300ms var(--ease-out), width 300ms var(--ease-out), height 300ms var(--ease-out), background-color 200ms var(--ease-out)
